# Egress allowlist for skill bodies.
# One host or parent domain per line; a URL host matches if it equals an entry
# or is a subdomain of it. Lines after `#` are comments.
#
# The skill security scanner (.github/scripts/skill_security_scan.py) flags any
# https?:// host in a skill body that is NOT covered here as a MEDIUM finding,
# so a maintainer reviews new network destinations before merge.
#
# Add a host here ONLY after confirming the skill legitimately needs to reach it.

# --- K8squad + project ---
k8squad.io
charts.k8squad.io

# --- source hosting / package registries the skills reference ---
github.com
raw.githubusercontent.com
api.github.com
pkg.go.dev
golang.org
go.dev

# --- vendors used by catalog skills ---
dynatrace.com

# --- upstream project docs commonly linked from skill bodies ---
kubernetes.io
apache.org
